success.description: Indicates if parsing was successful. True if all items were parsed successfully, false if parsing failed or input was irrelevant.

message.description: Optional message describing why parsing failed. Always null if success is true.

items.description: List of extracted food and drink items, each converted to grams. Empty if success is false.

name.description: The food or drink name, including any descriptors but not brand.

canonical_name.description: The canonical base food name for deduplication (e.g., 'a handful of carrots' -> 'carrot', 'fresh organic apples' -> 'apple'). Strip all quantity descriptors, size descriptors, preparation methods, and plural forms to get the singular base food item.

grams.description: The equivalent weight of this item in grams.

user_quantity.description: The number from the user's input, if available, else null.

user_unit.description: The explicit unit from user input (e.g., 'cup', 'slice', 'can', 'handfull', 'grams', 'tbsp', 'bowls', etc), or null if not given.

brand.description: The exact brand or product name mentioned, or null if not specified.

context.description: Contextual information about the item, e.g., 'for a salad', 'as a snack', etc., or null if it cannot be determined.
